Yongchanghe is professional in UV-Curing since 2001

Shenzhen Yongchanghe Technology Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Meilianxing Technology Co., Ltd. It is a professional company in UV light curing with decades of experience in development and manufacturing.
One of our shareholders ,Professor Li ,has been engaged in 3D printing for 20 years, and is one of the senior research scientists at Chinese Academy of Sciences.

In order to offer 'the most reasonable price, the highest quality products and the most satisfying services', we have built a 20,000 square meter international standard chemical factory equipped with international advanced production equipment and modern production lines, including about 30 reaction stills and plastic modification machines.

The reaction stills not only modify 3d resin, but also make mass production more efficient.The fully automatic filling system operates at 3 seconds per bottle on each production line and also automatically handles capping and labeling.
We are planning to build a facility for filament production, which will accommodate around 80 production lines including dual tri-color and rainbow PLA production.

The most important aspect is that we have an engineering team and plastic modification machines to produce a wide variety of 3D printing filaments like Light weight pla, carbon pla, carbon abs, glass fiber pla etc.
The testing lab is equipped with high-end equipment to test mechanical properties such as strength tension, bending strength, hardness,shrinkage, etc.

We also have professional machines such as thermal deformation temperature tester, aging resistance machine, constant temperature humidity chamber, thermal expansion coefficient tester and flexibility testing machine.

Our R&D technical team will keep up with the pace of global scientific and technological innovation.We are committed to providing customers with the world's top 3D printing products and will continue to explore user experience so that more people and enterprises can enjoy the practical benefits of 3d printing.
